title: sorghum × hewisonii

This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its potential to help manage diabetes and its ability to lower cholesterol levels due to its high fiber content. The bioactive constituents of Sorghum × hewisonii include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and other phytochemicals that contribute to its medicinal properties.
